title: Registries

empty.title: No registries configured

detail.author: Author

settings.title: Registry settings
settings.subtitle: Manage registry adapters and Claude marketplaces that supply skills and plugins.
settings.noneDescription: Add your first registry adapter or Claude marketplace to start browsing.
settings.warningBody: Registry adapters are executable TypeScript — only install them from sources you trust. Claude marketplaces are JSON catalogs and do not run adapter code.

actions.deleteConfirm: Remove registry "{{slug}}"? This deletes its row and any cached files.

editDialog.title: Edit registry "{{slug}}"
editDialog.description: Repoint this slug at a different source. The new adapter is downloaded and validated before it replaces the existing one.
editDialog.descriptionMarketplace: Repoint this slug at a different Claude marketplace. The marketplace.json catalog is re-fetched before it replaces the existing one.
editDialog.slugImmutable: The slug is the registry's identity and cannot be renamed. Remove and re-add to change it.
editDialog.noChanges: No changes — Save closes the dialog.

addDialog.title: Add registry
addDialog.description: Fetch an adapter from a Git repository or HTTPS URL. The file is downloaded and validated before it is enabled.
addDialog.descriptionMarketplace: Add a Claude Code marketplace by owner/repo. Capa fetches .claude-plugin/marketplace.json and lists its plugins.
addDialog.marketplaceHint: Claude marketplaces are JSON catalogs — no executable adapter code.

fields.slugHint: URL-safe identifier; auto-derived from the source if left blank.
